PM Narendra Modi Inaugurated Nitish Setu: pradhanmantri narendr modi shanivar dophar bihar ke vaishali men ganga par bane kachchi dargah-bidupur siks len pul ka udghatan kiya. brij ka nam bihar ke purv siem aur rajyasbha sansad nitish kumar ke nam par ‘nitish setu’ rakha gaya hai.
